faqs.q: What does a Big Project typically cost?
faqs.a: Most land between $28,000 and $150,000, custom-scoped after a Needs Assessment — the final quote reflects the number of systems, integrations, compliance work, and SLA tier, scoped in writing before any build. Care plans run from $6,000/mo. Equity-for-services is available for startups.

faqs.q: Needs Assessment — which mode do I need?
faqs.a: Same engagement, two modes. Pre-build mode: you have little or no AI in production and want to know what to build first. Reliability mode: AI you already shipped is breaking, drifting, or burning money — you get a failure taxonomy, evaluation plan, and a prioritized fix backlog. Both are 1–2 weeks, $2,500 / KES 200K, with 50% credited toward a build.

faqs.q: What do the monthly care plans actually cover?
faqs.a: Hosting, monitoring, prompt and model tweaks, dependency and security updates, plus usage analytics. Starter care is $1,400/mo; Big Project care starts at $6,000/mo and adds monthly feature releases, SLA-backed response times, and quarterly business reviews. Cancel anytime.

faqs.q: Are your KES prices a currency conversion?
faqs.a: No. KES prices use a local-market convention (~KES 80 per USD, below the ~130 spot rate) — a published local schedule for Kenyan clients, not an auto-conversion. The two currencies are priced as separate schedules, so USD and KES figures are not equivalent spot conversions.

faqs.q: Do you work with small businesses or only big companies?
faqs.a: All sizes. The Starter Build ($10,000 / KES 800K) is designed for SMBs, solo founders, and NGOs — one tool, shipped in weeks. Big Projects serve mid-market and enterprise teams commissioning multi-system programs. The Needs Assessment fits both.

faqs.q: Can you build AI that works in Swahili?
faqs.a: Yes. Multilingual AI (English · Français · Kiswahili · Luganda · Amharic) is a core specialty. I built Tapi Learn (acla.io/tapi-learn) with full EN/FR/SW support and 11K+ learners across 38 countries.

faqs.q: What if I don't know what AI can do for my business?
faqs.a: That's exactly what the Needs Assessment is for — $2,500, 1–2 weeks, and you leave with a ranked opportunity map and a pilot ready to build. You can also take the free 2-minute readiness score or book the free 30-minute call first.

Yes. Standard terms are 50% upfront, 50% on delivery, and multi-month schedules are common for Big Projects. Starter Builds can be split across milestones. Equity-for-services is available for early-stage startups.

faqs.q: Where are you based? Do you work remotely?
faqs.a: I'm based in Nairobi, Kenya. I work with clients globally (remote-first, async-friendly). For East African clients, I can do on-site workshops and kickoffs in Nairobi.

Python, TypeScript, Next.js, React, Flutter, TensorFlow Lite, PyTorch, LangChain, PostgreSQL, Prisma, n8n, Docker. For LLMs: GLM-4.6, GPT-4, Claude, Gemini, Llama — whatever fits the use case and budget.

faqs.q: How do you handle data privacy?
faqs.a: All client data is handled per Kenya Data Protection Act 2019 and GDPR. On-prem or private-cloud deployment available for sensitive workloads. No client data is used to train shared models. Full data processing agreement on retainer.

faqs.q: Can you train my team to use AI?
faqs.a: Yes. I offer half-day ($600/person) to 5-day ($36K/team) workshops. Non-technical to technical audiences. Topics include prompt engineering, RAG, multi-agent systems, MLOps, and AI ethics.
